user.description: Set up a light-based wake-up and wind-down alarm. All values can be changed later from the integration's options.

data.name: Name
data.prewake_minutes: Start ramping up this many minutes before wake time
data.peak_offset_minutes: Reach peak brightness this many minutes after wake time
data.winddown_minutes: Start dimming down this many minutes before sleep time
data.update_interval_seconds: How often to update the lights during a ramp
data.turn_off_at_sleep: Turn lights off once sleep time is reached

error.color_temp_range: Warmest color temperature must not be greater than coolest color temperature.
